offering_description.value: Operates supermarkets in the southeastern US that sell groceries, fresh foods, pharmacy items, fuel and general merchandise to consumers. Also owns a fluid milk processing plant and produces some private-label dairy goods, and owns and leases out shopping center real estate.

primary_products.value: groceries; fresh meat and produce; deli and bakery items; dairy products; fuel

customer_segment.value: B2C: household grocery shoppers in the southeastern US

end_markets.value: grocery retail; consumer packaged goods; pharmacy; fuel retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: groceries, fresh foods, general merchandise, fuel and milk products sold to shoppers; rental or leasing: rent from tenants in company-owned shopping centers

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys goods from suppliers and sells to consumers through supermarkets and fuel centers; OEM / manufacturer: processes milk and dairy products, mostly for its own stores; asset operator: owns and leases shopping center real estate

geography_served.value: US regional: Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Alabama, Virginia and Kentucky

specialization.value: related lines: supermarkets with pharmacy and fuel, plus milk processing and real estate

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated supermarkets and fuel centers; online: curbside pickup and delivery ordering

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety (FDA, USDA), pharmacy licensing by state boards, alcohol and tobacco sales rules, fuel environmental rules
